errors.evidence: The chart is a horizontal bar chart, so the length ('дължината') of the bar is proportional to the value, not the height ('височината').
The description incorrectly identifies the bar for the period '1990-1995' as the shortest. Visually, the bar for the period '2002-2007' is the shortest.

The bar for '1990–1995' represents approximately 16.5-17%, not 'a little over 16%'. The bar for '2002-2007' is shorter, at about 16%, which contradicts the description's claim that '1990-1995' is the shortest.
The bar for '2002–2007' is the shortest on the chart, representing a value of approximately 16%, not 'about 17%'.
